function_v0.doc: Number of markets created so far (= the next deploy salt).
function_v0.name: count

function_v0.doc: `market_wasm` is the WASM hash freshly-deployed markets use; `registry`\nand `usdc` are resolved per-network at deploy time (build.md \xc2\xa70a).
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Create a scalar-Gaussian market. Set `capped_flag` to `1` for capped
Gaussians (sharp beliefs allowed; ADR-3). All numeric belief fields are WAD-scaled
(`1e18`; ADR-1/ADR-2). `tier` is the resolver's trust badge code
(`0..=3`; ADR-5). Returns the deployed market's address.
function_v0.name: create_market

function_v0.doc: Re-point the `DistributionMarket` WASM hash (e.g. after a contract\nupgrade); only affects markets created afterwards. Admin-gated.
function_v0.name: set_market_wasm

function_v0.doc:
Create a trajectory market: N independent per-checkpoint Gaussians
sharing one collateral pool (ADR-4, whitepaper \xc2\xa716). `checkpoints` are
Unix timestamps (ascending, \xe2\x89\xa4 `window_resolve`); `mus0`/`sigmas0` have
one entry per checkpoint, all WAD.
function_v0.name: create_trajectory_market

params.doc: The new aggregate belief after the trade.
params.name: belief

udt_struct_v0.doc: A Gaussian belief curve, stored as parameters (ADR-2): `f(x) = \xce\xbb \xc2\xb7 \xcf\x86_{\xce\xbc,\xcf\x83}(x)`\nwith `\xce\xbb = k\xc2\xb7\xe2\x88\x9a(2\xcf\x83\xe2\x88\x9a\xcf\x80)` so `\xe2\x80\x96f\xe2\x80\x96\xe2\x82\x82 = k`. All WAD. `\xce\xbb` is derived and stored\nredundantly so reads never recompute a square root.
udt_struct_v0.name: Belief

fields.doc: Width `\xcf\x83` (outcome units, WAD). Must satisfy `\xcf\x83 \xe2\x89\xa5 \xcf\x83_min` for the market.
fields.name: sigma

udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Canonical error space for the Kaido contracts. Numeric values are stable \xe2\x80\x94\noff-chain code (SDK, indexer) maps them to messages, so **never renumber an\nexisting variant**; only append.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: KaidoError

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The summary the [`Registry`] indexes for each market \xe2\x80\x94 enough for the
frontend's market list without a per-market `get_params` round-trip. The
market contract itself stays the source of truth for live state (belief,
status, pool).
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketInfo

fields.doc: The resolver's declared trust tier (the UI badge \xe2\x80\x94 ADR-5).
fields.name: tier

udt_struct_v0.doc: What `DistributionMarket::get_state()` returns: the live belief, the status,\nand the (constructor-computed) \xcf\x83-floor.
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketState

fields.doc: `\xcf\x83_min(k, b)` for this market \xe2\x80\x94 the smallest `\xcf\x83` a trade may set (ADR-3).
fields.name: sigma_min

udt_struct_v0.doc: `M = ( OutcomeSpace, Parameterization, k, b, fee, Resolver, Window )`\n(whitepaper \xc2\xa715). All numeric fields are WAD-scaled (ADR-2).
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketParams

fields.doc: Per-outcome collateral `b`. WAD. Must be `> 0`. (Converted from a 7-dp\nUSDC deposit at the contract boundary.)
fields.name: b

fields.doc: `false` \xe2\x87\x92 \xcf\x83-floor enforcement (default; ADR-3). `true` \xe2\x87\x92 capped Gaussian\n`f(x) = min(b, \xce\xbb\xcf\x86(x))` \xe2\x80\x94 reserved for Sprint 5; `init` rejects it now.
fields.name: capped

fields.doc: Trade fee in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%). Capped by the contract.
fields.name: fee_bps

fields.doc: L\xc2\xb2-norm liquidity constant `k` (`\xe2\x80\x96f\xe2\x80\x96\xe2\x82\x82 = k`). WAD. Must be `> 0`.
fields.name: k

fields.doc: The resolver contract (implements the `Resolver` interface; Sprint 2+).
fields.name: resolver

fields.doc: The resolver's declared trust tier \xe2\x80\x94 rendered as a badge everywhere\n(ADR-5).
fields.name: tier

udt_union_v0.doc: Lifecycle status of a market. Sprint 1 only ever sets `Open` (no\ntrading/resolution yet); `Locked` / `Resolved` and the oracle-failure\n`Disputable` state arrive in Sprint 2.
udt_union_v0.name: MarketStatus

tuple_v0.doc: Resolved; payouts settled. (Carries the realised outcome value, WAD.)
tuple_v0.name: Resolved

void_v0.doc: A trajectory market, resolved; the realised per-checkpoint values are\nstored alongside (see `DistributionMarket::resolved_outcomes`).
void_v0.name: ResolvedVec

void_v0.doc: The resolver returned a stale/garbage value \xe2\x80\x94 market is paused pending a\ndispute, never a bad payout (ADR-5; Sprint 2).
void_v0.name: Disputable

udt_struct_v0.doc: Trading window \xe2\x80\x94 Unix timestamps (ledger time, seconds). Requires\n`open \xe2\x89\xa4 lock \xe2\x89\xa4 resolve` and `resolve` in the future at construction time.
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketWindow

udt_union_v0.doc: The shape of a market's outcome. Sprint 1 ships **scalar** markets only;\ntrajectory markets (a path sampled at checkpoints) land in Sprint 2 (ADR-4)\nas an additional variant \xe2\x80\x94 adding it is non-breaking for existing markets.
udt_union_v0.name: OutcomeSpace

void_v0.doc: The outcome is a single real number (a price at `T`, an election margin,\na rainfall in mm, \xe2\x80\xa6). The belief is one [`Belief`].
void_v0.name: Scalar

tuple_v0.doc:
The outcome is a path sampled at N checkpoint timestamps (Unix
seconds, ascending). The belief is one [`Belief`] per checkpoint; the
checkpoints share one collateral pool (whitepaper \xc2\xa716; ADR-4). v1
treats the per-checkpoint Gaussians as independent.
tuple_v0.name: Trajectory

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A trader's position: the market curve immediately *before* the trade (`f`)
and immediately *after* (`g`), the collateral locked, and the owner \xe2\x80\x94
everything needed to compute the payout `g(x\xe2\x82\x80) \xe2\x88\x92 f(x\xe2\x82\x80)` at resolution
without storing any curve array (ADR-2, whitepaper \xc2\xa711). Used from Sprint 2.
udt_struct_v0.name: PositionData

fields.doc: Market belief just after this trade (`g`).
fields.name: after

fields.doc: Market belief just before this trade (`f`).
fields.name: before

fields.doc: Collateral the trader locked = worst-case loss `\xe2\x88\x92min_x(g\xe2\x88\x92f)` (WAD).
fields.name: collateral

udt_enum_v0.doc: Trust tier a resolver declares. Stored on-chain in [`MarketParams`] so the\nfrontend renders the badge from the source of truth, not from off-chain\nmetadata. Numeric values match the `T0\xe2\x80\xa6T3` naming in ADR-5 / whitepaper \xc2\xa717.
udt_enum_v0.name: ResolverTier

cases.doc: **T0** \xe2\x80\x94 reads a robust on-chain price feed (Reflector SEP-40). The\ndefault tier for on-chain price feeds (e.g. Reflector BTC/USD).
cases.name: Reflector

cases.doc: **T1** \xe2\x80\x94 a signed report from a permissioned poster, with a challenge\nwindow.
cases.name: Attested

cases.doc: **T2** \xe2\x80\x94 optimistic propose/dispute with bonds; undisputed-after-window\n\xe2\x87\x92 final.
cases.name: Optimistic

cases.doc: **T3** \xe2\x80\x94 a single named party reports. Pure trust, clearly flagged.
cases.name: Designated

event_v0.doc: Emitted by `DistributionMarket::init` (and, from Sprint 3, by `MarketFactory`\nwhen it deploys + initialises one): a new market exists, seeded with `belief`.
event_v0.name: MarketCreated

udt_union_v0.doc: Status a resolver reports for its market's outcome.
udt_union_v0.name: ResolverStatus

tuple_v0.doc: Available for a trajectory market \xe2\x80\x94 the realised value at each\ncheckpoint, in checkpoint order (all WAD).
tuple_v0.name: ResolvedVec

void_v0.doc: The underlying source is stale/garbage; the market should pause\n(`Disputable`), not pay out.
void_v0.name: Stale

udt_union_v0.doc:
How a belief is parameterised. Sprint 1 ships `Gaussian` only; richer
families (right-skewed, multi-modal \xe2\x80\x94 build.md E18, post-M3) are added as
further variants. (`#[contracttype]` enum variants can't carry named fields,
so the \xcf\x83-floor-vs-capped choice is a separate `capped: bool` on
[`MarketParams`], not a payload here.)
udt_union_v0.name: Parameterization

event_v0.doc: Emitted by `DistributionMarket::resolve` for a trajectory market\n(topic `"resolved_trajectory"`).
event_v0.name: ResolvedTrajectory

params.doc: Realised value at each checkpoint, in checkpoint order (WAD).
params.name: x0s

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A trajectory trader's position: the per-checkpoint curves before and after
the trade, the aggregate collateral locked, and the owner. At resolution the
payout is `\xce\xa3_i (g_i(x_i) \xe2\x88\x92 f_i(x_i))` over the N checkpoints, returned (with
the collateral) clamped at `0`.
udt_struct_v0.name: TrajectoryPositionData

fields.doc: Per-checkpoint market beliefs just after this trade.
fields.name: after

fields.doc: Per-checkpoint market beliefs just before this trade.
fields.name: before
